title: Registry Helper Options Schema
description: Generates a helper class under src/app/shared/helpers.

name.description: The name for the new helper.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the helper?

project.description: The name of the project where the file should be added.

path.description: The folder where the file is created, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to src/app/shared/helpers.
